scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:app && npx cap sync && node scripts/normalize-capacitor-spm-paths.mjs
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android && node scripts/normalize-capacitor-spm-paths.mjs
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build:app && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/normalize-capacitor-spm-paths.mjs
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleDebug
scripts.android:bundle:release: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:numeric && npm run test:weather-points && npm run test:native-config
